# Metric definitions

Source of truth: [`metrics/metrics.yml`](../metrics/metrics.yml). The SQL below is what the cross-check test runs on the marts; `src/olist/metrics.py` implements the same definitions in pandas for the dashboard, and the test requires both to agree.

## Revenue is not payment value is not GMV

| Quantity | Formula | What it is | Observed? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Item revenue | SUM(price) | merchandise value paid to sellers | yes |
| Freight | SUM(freight_value) | shipping charged to customers, passed to carriers | yes |
| GMV | item revenue + freight | gross merchandise value of valid orders | yes |
| Payment value | SUM(payment_value) | cash charged; includes instalment interest and vouchers | yes |
| Marketplace revenue (estimate) | take rate x item revenue | Olist's own revenue | **no**: assumed take rate |
| Contribution (estimate) | marketplace revenue - payment cost (- subsidies) | a profit proxy | **no**: assumptions only |

## Assumptions

| Name | Value | Label | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `take_rate` | 0.1 | Marketplace commission on item revenue | Olist's commission and fees are not in the dataset. 10% is an illustrative value for a marketplace take rate; change it in the dashboard's simulation pages. |
| `payment_cost_rate` | 0.02 | Payment processing cost as a share of payment value | Not in the dataset; illustrative card/boleto processing cost. |

## Customer

| Metric | Unit | Kind | Definition | SQL |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Customers** (`customers`) | count | observed | Distinct people (customer_unique_id) with at least one valid order. | `SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1` |
| **New customers** (`new_customers`) | count | observed | People whose first valid order ever falls in the selection. | `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1 AND customer_order_seq = 1` |
| **Returning customers** (`returning_customers`) | count | observed | People with a second or later valid order in the selection. | `SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1 AND customer_order_seq > 1` |
| **Repeat-customer rate** (`repeat_rate`) | share | observed | Of the people acquired in the selection (first valid order in it), the share whose second valid order is also in the selection. *Caveat: Customers acquired late have had less time to return (right-censoring).* | `SELECT 1.0 * COUNT(s.customer_unique_id) / COUNT(*) AS value FROM fct_orders AS f LEFT JOIN fct_orders AS s ON s.customer_unique_id = f.customer_unique_id AND s.customer_order_seq = 2 WHERE f.is_valid = 1 AND f.customer_order_seq = 1` |
| **GMV per customer (observed)** (`gmv_per_customer`) | BRL | observed | GMV / customers in the selection. Observed historical value, not a forecast. | `SELECT SUM(gmv) / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1` |
| **Orders per customer** (`orders_per_customer`) | count | observed | Valid orders / customers. | `SELECT 1.0 * COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1` |

## Delivery

| Metric | Unit | Kind | Definition | SQL |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Average delivery time** (`avg_delivery_days`) | days | observed | Mean calendar days from purchase to delivery, delivered valid orders. | `SELECT AVG(1.0 * delivery_days) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1 AND is_delivered = 1` |
| **Average promised time** (`avg_promised_days`) | days | observed | Mean days from purchase to the estimated date shown at checkout, delivered orders. | `SELECT AVG(1.0 * estimated_days) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1 AND is_delivered = 1` |
| **Late deliveries** (`late_rate`) | share | observed | Delivered valid orders that arrived after the estimated date / delivered valid orders. | `SELECT AVG(1.0 * is_late) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1 AND is_delivered = 1` |
| **Days late when late** (`avg_days_late_when_late`) | days | observed | Mean days after the estimated date, over late orders only. | `SELECT AVG(1.0 * delay_days) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1 AND is_late = 1` |

## Order

| Metric | Unit | Kind | Definition | SQL |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Orders** (`orders`) | count | observed | Number of valid orders. | `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1` |
| **Orders placed** (`orders_placed`) | count | observed | All orders, including cancelled and unavailable ones. | `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fct_orders` |
| **Cancellation rate** (`cancellation_rate`) | share | observed | Orders with status canceled or unavailable / orders placed. | `SELECT 1.0 * SUM(is_cancelled) / COUNT(*) FROM fct_orders` |
| **Delivery completion** (`delivery_completion_rate`) | share | observed | Delivered orders / orders placed. *Caveat: Orders placed near the end of the extract may still be in transit.* | `SELECT 1.0 * SUM(is_delivered) / COUNT(*) FROM fct_orders` |
| **Items per order** (`items_per_order`) | count | observed | Items sold / valid orders. | `SELECT 1.0 * SUM(n_items) / COUNT(*) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1` |

## Payment

| Metric | Unit | Kind | Definition | SQL |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Orders paid mainly by credit card** (`credit_card_share`) | share | observed | Valid orders whose largest payment is by credit card / valid orders with a payment. | `SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN main_payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1 AND main_payment_type IS NOT NULL` |
| **Average instalments** (`avg_installments`) | count | observed | Mean of the largest instalment count per valid order. | `SELECT AVG(1.0 * installments) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1` |

## Product

| Metric | Unit | Kind | Definition | SQL |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Categories sold** (`active_categories`) | count | observed | Distinct product categories with at least one item on a valid order. | `SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT category) FROM fct_order_items WHERE is_valid = 1` |

## Revenue

| Metric | Unit | Kind | Definition | SQL |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Item revenue** (`item_revenue`) | BRL | observed | Sum of item prices on valid orders. Excludes freight. | `SELECT SUM(item_revenue) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1` |
| **Freight charged** (`freight_value`) | BRL | observed | Sum of freight charged to customers on valid orders. Not Olist revenue. | `SELECT SUM(freight_value) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1` |
| **GMV** (`gmv`) | BRL | observed | Gross merchandise value = item revenue + freight, on valid orders. *Caveat: Before returns and refunds, which the dataset does not record.* | `SELECT SUM(gmv) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1` |
| **Payment value** (`payment_value`) | BRL | observed | Sum of payments recorded on valid orders (cash charged to customers). *Caveat: Differs from GMV on a few hundred orders (instalment interest, vouchers, rounding); it is not revenue.* | `SELECT SUM(payment_value) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1` |
| **Average order value** (`aov`) | BRL | observed | GMV / valid orders. | `SELECT SUM(gmv) / COUNT(*) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1` |
| **Freight share of GMV** (`freight_share_of_gmv`) | share | observed | Freight charged / GMV. | `SELECT SUM(freight_value) / SUM(gmv) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1` |
| **GMV growth, last month vs previous** (`gmv_mom_growth`) | share | observed | GMV of the last complete month in the selection / GMV of the month before - 1. *Caveat: Month-on-month growth is noisy; read it with the 3-month average in SQL 01.* | `WITH m AS (SELECT purchase_month, SUM(gmv) AS gmv FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1 GROUP BY purchase_month) SELECT (SELECT gmv FROM m ORDER BY purchase_month DESC LIMIT 1) / (SELECT gmv FROM m ORDER BY purchase_month DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) - 1 AS value` |
| **Marketplace revenue (estimate)** (`marketplace_revenue_estimate`) | BRL | estimate | take_rate x item revenue. An estimate of Olist's own revenue. *Caveat: The dataset has no commission data; the take rate is an assumption.* | `SELECT {take_rate} * SUM(item_revenue) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1` |
| **Contribution (estimate)** (`contribution_estimate`) | BRL | estimate | Marketplace revenue estimate - payment_cost_rate x payment value. A rough profit proxy before fixed costs, marketing and any shipping subsidy. *Caveat: Built only from assumptions applied to observed volumes; not observed profit.* | `SELECT {take_rate} * SUM(item_revenue) - {payment_cost_rate} * SUM(payment_value) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1` |

## Review

| Metric | Unit | Kind | Definition | SQL |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Average review** (`avg_review`) | stars | observed | Mean review score (1-5) of valid orders with a review (orders with several reviews use their mean). | `SELECT AVG(review_score) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1 AND review_score IS NOT NULL` |
| **1-2 star reviews** (`bad_review_rate`) | share | observed | Share of reviewed valid orders with a mean score of 2 or less. | `SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN review_score <= 2 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1 AND review_score IS NOT NULL` |
| **Review gap, on time minus late** (`review_gap_late`) | stars | observed | Mean review of on-time delivered orders minus mean review of late ones. *Caveat: An association in observational data, not the causal effect of lateness.* | `SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN is_late = 0 THEN review_score END) - AVG(CASE WHEN is_late = 1 THEN review_score END) AS value FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1 AND is_delivered = 1 AND review_score IS NOT NULL` |

## Seller

| Metric | Unit | Kind | Definition | SQL |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Active sellers** (`active_sellers`) | count | observed | Distinct sellers with at least one item on a valid order. | `SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) FROM fct_order_items WHERE is_valid = 1` |
| **Item revenue per active seller** (`item_revenue_per_seller`) | BRL | observed | Item revenue / active sellers. | `SELECT SUM(item_revenue) / COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) FROM fct_order_items WHERE is_valid = 1` |
